text:
SRE Pager: :rotating_light: PAGER — prod-router | region=us-west-2 | symptom=p99 latency spike >2s for streaming endpoints. Window=3m. Escalation: oncall @Alex S. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/router/latency?region=us-west-2

Alex S.: Ack, I'm oncall. Paging into channel. On call now.

Alex S.: Quick context: we launched a routing policy tweak 08:12 UTC that touched header-based matching for streaming. Maria, can you confirm if traffic is being skewed to any backend?

Maria G.: pulling LB metrics now.

Maria G.: Here's the heatmap: backend lb-backend-7 is seeing 10x higher p99. Top keys show partition key "policy:experimental-v3" is hot.

Maria G.: Querying router logs for policy matches:```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/router/us-west-2/access.log | grep "policy=experimental-v3" | awk '{print $1,$6,$9}' | head
2026-03-14T08:18:03Z session-xx GET 200
2026-03-14T08:18:04Z session-yy GET 200
```

Jon P.: I pushed that policy tweak. I didn't intend to catch streaming endpoints — I tried to weight a small control group but the header matcher may be too broad. Looking at the change: commit 3f7a2b2 added match on `X-Client-Variant` with regex `.*v3` which could match other clients.

Sam K.: I'm seeing streaming stalls in the traces: KV-cache misses + cold host for lb-backend-7. Traces: https://traces.internal/trace/abcd1234

Alex S.: Customer impact: Customer Success reports ~15% of active streaming sessions experienced stalls >5s in the last 10m. CS: any affected customers flagged?

Customer Success: Yes — 3 paying customers opened tickets showing degraded quality. One has a live demo running. We're escalating their priority.

Rita (oncall-bot): :information_source: Reminder: collect service-level impact numbers before rolling. Run `metrics query` for p95/p99.

Maria G.: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 480ms, p99 from 340ms -> 2.6s in us-west-2. Traffic fraction to lb-backend-7 ~ 38% of requests in the last 5m.

Jon P.: I agree this is likely a policy-match bug creating a hot partition. I can revert the policy immediately if we want to rollback.

Alex S.: What's the blast radius of rollback? Any config that would break other regions?

Jon P.: This policy is scoped to us-west-2 and router service only. Revert should be safe. I'll prepare the rollback but want to try a targeted mitigation first: force-route streaming endpoints to the stable route in us-west-2 to avoid the experimental pool.

Sam K.: If we can change weights via admin API, we can move 100% traffic off lb-backend-7 to stable pool. Doing that will preserve session affinity? Need to check.

Maria G.: Session affinity is sticky per session key; forcing route will send new sessions to stable. Existing stuck sessions may need a reconnect.

Alex S.: Ok do mitigation now: either patch policy or override route. Jon, do route override. Sam, prepare rollback steps. Maria, monitor.

Jon P.: Applying override via admin API now:```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/routes/override" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"service":"router","region":"us-west-2","filter":"streaming","target":"stable","weight":100}'
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Route override applied by jon_p at 08:22:41 UTC. Audit id: audit-9921

Maria G.: Seeing immediate improvement in tail latencies for new sessions. p99 trending down from 2.6s -> 800ms in first 60s.

Customer Success: Noted decrease in new incidents from customers. They're testing the demo again.

Alex S.: For existing stuck sessions, is it worth forcing session reconnect? Any risk?

Sam K.: We can gracefully drain lb-backend-7 by toggling `accept_new=false`. That will let live sessions finish and new ones go to stable. I'll issue drain now.

Sam K.: Draining backend lb-backend-7:```
adminctl backend drain --backend=lb-backend-7 --grace=30
```

ops-bot: :information_source: Drain command queued, backend will finish existing connections.

Maria G.: p99 now at 320ms after override+drain. Stalls dropping in traces.

Alex S.: Big picture: policy bug caused oversized match, created hot partition routing to an under-provisioned backend, which amplified tail latency. Mitigation: route override + drain. Next: rollback the policy and create a stricter matcher.

Jon P.: Rolling back commit 3f7a2b2 now (revert PR 482).```
git revert 3f7a2b2 -m "revert experimental header matcher"
git push origin main
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Revert PR merged at 08:30:05 UTC. CI: green.

Maria G.: Confirming config in us-west-2 no longer contains experimental-v3 rule. Backend load distribution normalized.

Alex S.: Customer impact summary for postmortem: ~12 customers touched (3 opened tickets), p99 spike to 2.6s, duration ~28m from first spike to stable baseline. Will capture exact graphs.

Customer Success: We're following up with the 3 customers and offering incident write-ups.

Rita (oncall-bot): :page_with_curl: Please assign postmortem owner and add labels: root_cause=routing_policy_bug, severity=sev2, mitigation=route_override+rollback.

Alex S.: Postmortem owner: Jon P. I'll take ops/mitigation notes. Maria, Sam — please add monitoring followups (alert tuning, backend capacity).

Jon P.: I'll own the postmortem. Action items: 1) tighten header regex, 2) add preflight test for policy pushes, 3) add lb hot-partition alert (spike to single-backend >25% traffic).

Alex S.: Handoff: I'm on-call for 30 more minutes, then handoff to Maria at 1762804500 UTC. If anything regresses re-pager immediately.

Maria G.: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the dashboard for the next 2 hours.

Alex S.: Thanks everyone. Closing incident when baseline holds for 30m and CS confirms customer issues resolved. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked mitigated at 08:44:10 UTC by alex_s. Metrics will be archived to incident-1762801234.
